The '''room of six shadows''' was a chamber within the [[Asteroid/Legends|asteroid]] [[I-9]], in the [[Cularin asteroid belt]]. The chamber was created by the incorporeal [[Oblee|shadow lurkers]]&mdash;disembodied spirits of the Oblee [[Species/Legends|species]]&mdash;as a defense to help contain the [[Darkstaff]], an ancient [[Sith artifact/Legends|Sith artifact]] that was housed within the asteroid. The room contained six shadows, each corresponding with a [[Planet/Legends|planetary]] body in the [[Cularin system/Legends|Cularin system]], and only by passing through the shadow that represented the world [[Oblis]] could the chamber in which the Darkstaff was situated be accessed. Passing through the shadow that represented the planet [[Cularin/Legends|Cularin]] would cause an individual to suffer injuries, while passing through any of the other shadows brought about the onset of insanity.
